whenToUse: A workspace event stream with live updates queued behind a new-events pill.
Following records, filtering by topic and seeing who is active now.
avoidWhen: Compliance audit trails with diffs — use list-09.
Notifications addressed to the user — use notification-center.
a11y: New events do not shift the page; counts are announced in a role="status" / aria-live region.
Infinite loading sets aria-busy and keeps a button fallback with a clear end.
